catalog.not_enough_at_least_150: —  not enough, at least 150 GB needed
catalog.epic_offers_prebuilt_unreal_engi: Epic offers a prebuilt Unreal Engine archive for Linux (20+ GB) on its website — you only need an Epic account and the accepted license. Click “Download” next to the version you need and download the archive on the site — the launcher shows a progress bar and offers to unpack and register the engine. You can also paste a direct link — then the launcher downloads it itself, with resume.
engines_page.fab_epic_s_asset_store: Fab is Epic’s asset store. The plugin adds a Fab window to the editor (a button next to “Save All” in the Content Drawer).
store_page.google_does_not_allow_embedde: Google does not allow embedded browsers. Option 1: sign in to unrealengine.com in your regular browser (Google sign-in works), then click “Transfer sign-in from a browser” and pick it. Option 2: sign in with e-mail and password (the password is set at epicgames.com → Account → Password).
settings.https_token_gh_auth_setup: HTTPS — token or gh auth setup-git
settings.ipv6_loopback_disabled_zen_unav: IPv6 on loopback is disabled — Zen is unavailable; in “Auto” mode the cache is kept in a folder on disk.
versions.github_did_not_accept_ssh: GitHub did not accept the SSH key. Add the public key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) in GitHub → Settings → SSH keys, or switch to HTTPS in the settings. A passphrase-protected key must be loaded into ssh-agent.
settings.wayland_do_not_use_ue: Wayland — DO NOT use: UE 5.7 crashes (segfault in Vulkan)
settings.zen_unreal_s_local_cache: Zen — Unreal’s local cache server (needs IPv6 on loopback)
